reply.thought: The first step is to check if the refunds reported by Alpha Co match what is in the system. I will use the list_refunds() tool to get the current refund records for comparison.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds listed in the system. Now I need to list all orders to determine which customers to pay and what their net balances are. I will use the list_orders() tool.

I have the orders and confirmed the refunds match. Now, I need to calculate the net balance for each customer using the net_balance(customer) tool. The customers involved are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will check them one by one.
Acme's net balance is 19075 cents. Now I will check the next customer, 'birch'.
Birch's net balance is 24548 cents. Now I will check the last customer, 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (19075), birch (24548), and cobalt (44488). The next step is to record a payout for each customer using the record_payout tool, as per the instructions. I will record them sequentially.
Payout recorded for acme. Now I will record the payout for birch.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finish the task by summarizing the payouts.
